{"metadata":{"description":"🐤 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）永久插件：Deep diving 回答期间用坤宠动图填满深潜状态行下方区块——进度条 0%→100%，每 20% 切换动作与文案，完成时系统级播放「你干嘛~哎哟」","id":"gh:1335044426","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-ikun-pet","slug":"eric-song-dev/dsh-ikun-pet","topics":["deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","ikun","ikun-pet","plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"🐤 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）永久插件：Deep diving 回答期间用坤宠动图填满深潜状态行下方区块——进度条 0%→100%，每 20% 切换动作与文案，完成时系统级播放「你干嘛"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"epSeek Harness（DSH）永久插件：Deep diving 回答期间用坤宠动图填满深潜状态行下方区块——进度条 0%→100%，每 20% 切换动作与文案，完成时系统级播放「你干嘛~哎哟」"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# 🐤 dsh-ikun-pet · ikun Desktop Pet"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> 📖 中文文档：README.zh.md"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that fills the full row under the **"Deep diving..." status line**"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" with an ikun pet during **every reply**:
> a `0% → 100%` progress bar, **a new animation and text e"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"very 20%**, and a jump celebration with a system-level "你干嘛~哎哟" voice cue at completion 🏀"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## ✨ Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Only fills the deep-dive dock**: registered at `conversation.input.dock` — the full row directly"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" below
DSH's "Deep diving..." status line, between the conversation and the composer. Visible only w"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"hile a
session is `running` (deep diving); completely invisible the rest of the time.
- **The pet wa"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"lks the progress bar**: the ikun pet walks from 3% to 97%, playing frame-by-frame on top of
the prog"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"ress bar (8 columns × 9 rows sprite-sheet contract).
- **A new stage every 20%**: six stages at 0/20"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"/40/60/80/100, each switching both the animation and the
text (see docs/PROGRESS-STAGES.md).
- **Uni"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"versal adaptive progress**: a layered estimation model — real anchors (0% start / 100% done) +
real "},{"id":"p6s8","text":"goal-round progress + self-calibration from this session's turn durations + activity pacing for
tool"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"s/streaming/approval-waiting + a shrinking reserve. Short tasks run fast, long tasks run slow,
waiti"},{"id":"p6s10","text":"ng for your approval slows it down honestly, and it never fakes 100%
(details in docs/PROGRESS-STAGE"},{"id":"p6s11","text":"S.md).
- **Completion heard system-wide**: at 100% the host process plays "你干嘛~哎哟" (`assets/voice.mp"},{"id":"p6s12","text":"3`)
with a system command — audible from any window and any session, independent of browser mute
(te"},{"id":"p6s13","text":"sted on macOS).
- **Permanent plugin form**: written into the DSH composition (`cordis.patch.yml`) a"},{"id":"p6s14","text":"nd auto-loaded on
every DSH start — install once, works in every session. Dynamic-plugin sources (`s"},{"id":"p6s15","text":"rc/`) are kept as
an alternative for session-level installs."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## 🚀 Install"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"**Option A: clone** (for tinkerers)"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"**Option B: remote one-liner** (for users)"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**Option C: npm** (prebuilt — installs without the `allowBuilds` build-approval step)"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"> 💡 If your profile isn't named `web`, swap `--profile web` for your own profile name in the command"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"our profile isn't named `web`, swap `--profile web` for your own profile name in the commands above."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Then restart `dsh web` and refresh the browser. Verify:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## 🎬 Stage → animation → text"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| Progress | Animation | Text |
| ---: | --- | --- |
| 0% – 20% | waiting | 深潜启动！准备出发… |
| 20% – 40%"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" | runRight | 正在收集线索… |
| 40% – 60% | working | 埋头苦干中… |
| 60% – 80% | review | 认真思考中… |
| 80% – 100"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"% | wave | 快好啦！马上见结果~ |
| 100% (done) | jump | 完成啦！你干嘛~哎哟 🔉 (host plays the voice cue) |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## ⚙️ Configuration (optional)"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Everything lives in the plugin line's `config` inside the bundled `cordis.patch.yml`:
`spritePath` /"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" `voicePath` / `playVoiceAtDone` / `playCommand` (assets default to the bundled `assets/`)."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- **Disable**: remove the `#` in front of `# disabled: true`, restart `dsh web` (put it back to re-e"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"nable)

- **Vo"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"ice on Windows/Linux**: swap `playCommand` to PowerShell / ffplay (examples in the comments;
